repo.description: The DID or handle of the repository/account to create the record in

collection.description: The Lexicon schema collection namespace for the record type (e.g. app.bsky.feed.post)

record.description: The record object to store. Schema depends on the collection type.

$type.description: The Lexicon type identifier for the record (e.g. app.bsky.feed.post)

text.description: The text content of the post

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the post was created, preferably with trailing Z (e.g. 2023-08-07T05:31:12.156888Z)

uri.description: The AT URI of the newly created record

cid.description: The content identifier (CID) of the newly created record
